parameters.note: The tilt the capture screen still calls level (K-601). H1 2.4: a level/tilt indicator is one of the three cheap aids that standardise the pose (Wong 2021: pose standardisation halves the precision error); the research gives no tolerance. Two degrees: within what a hand on a phone stand holds, small enough that the frame does not visibly lean. Product choice, no source for the number.

How strongly the last photo of the same pose shows over the viewfinder (H1 2.4: onion-skin overlay of the previous photo). Faint enough to see the live picture through it, strong enough to line up with. Product choice.
The self-timer (prototype 4.1 '10 s timer'): H1 2.4 asks for a fixed distance with the camera at chest height, so the phone stands and the user steps back into the frame. Product choice.
How often the capture screen reads the accelerometer for its level (K-601): five times a second follows a hand without redrawing on every sensor tick. Product choice.
How far one VoiceOver swipe moves the slide comparison's divide (K-602): a tenth of the width. Dragging moves it freely. Product choice.
The camera's JPEG compression for a progress photo (expo-camera takePictureAsync quality, 0-1). Kept on the phone only and compared by eye; high enough that the outline is sharp. Product choice.

How far the smoothed lean may drift before the capture screen stops calling the phone straight (hysteresis around photo_level_tolerance_deg, K-1055). Without a gap, a hand hovering at the tolerance flipped the word on every reading. Twice the tolerance: a stand-held phone stays straight through a nudge, a real lean is called. Product choice, no source for the number.

The weight of each new accelerometer reading in the capture screen's smoothed lean (exponential moving average, 0-1; K-1055): fifteen parts in a hundred of the new reading, the rest of what was. At photo_level_update_ms apart it follows a lean in about a second and ignores the tremor and a single jolt in between (one reading up to about 26 degrees off does not move a straight phone past photo_level_exit_deg). Product choice.

The self-timer choices on the capture screen (K-1055), 0 meaning off: none for someone holding the phone, a short one, and the stand's. photo_timer_seconds and photo_timer_hand_seconds must be among them. Product choice.
The timer the capture screen starts with when someone else holds the phone (K-1055): off, 0 seconds. The stand's start is photo_timer_seconds. Product choice.
